name: savr-cors-proxy
description: Token-locked CORS proxy for the Savr reader (Cloudflare Worker, or self-hosted Node server)

PROXY_TOKENS.description: Secret token(s) that lock this proxy — a comma-separated list, so you can rotate without downtime. Paste the UUID shown on the worker's setup page (or generate one with `openssl rand -hex 24`). Leave blank only if you really want an open proxy.
